target.purpose: Screen annotator pairs for unusually high agreement relative to independent annotator-specific empirical marginals, producing deterministic evidence without converting an anomaly into a misconduct finding.
target.central_bottleneck: Raw agreement can look suspicious or benign simply because annotators have different label marginals; integrity screening needs a chance-adjusted, overlap-bounded, reproducible signal with an explicit claim ceiling.
success: Chance agreement uses independent annotator-specific empirical marginals.
Pairs below the minimum shared-item overlap are not screened.
Observed agreement lift is compared with an explicit margin policy.
Duplicate annotator/item rows and malformed dimensions fail closed.
Input and policy identity are bound into pair/report receipts.
Python and C preserve the corrected statistical baseline.
A flag remains an anomaly requiring investigation, not proof of misconduct.

invariants: input and policy identities are receipt-bound
screening result never implies misconduct adjudication

donor_plan.basis: This repository owns pairwise agreement-anomaly screening; Scale-lens siblings own evaluation contamination and annotation-budget allocation.

nonclaims: flagged agreement is not proof of collusion or misconduct
not a production Scale AI labeling-integrity service
no annotator identity authentication or disciplinary action
no exercised integration with contamination or annotation-budget siblings
